fusions.name: Fanned Embers
fusions.desc: A wide cut that fans flame: it deals 12 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you and sets them [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Heat Treatment
fusions.desc: Presses the hot blade into the target: it deals 10 damage, sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Forge Retort
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and it sets them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck Sparks
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
